R106 (rev. 2026-09-26: edge wording per review research-20260926-r102-r106-review.md; v1 output preserved as r106-team-art-inspection-graph-v1-20260925T2217.json) - team-art INSPECTION graph (Legacy X360 / PS3 first; review 2026-09-25 R97-R101): derived only from published JSONs (R56 handoff
facts cited, R102 layout, R103 per-row joins, R103b / R104 aliases and payload references). No new measurement. Nodes = DB identities and
asset objects; edges = typed relations with an evidence status. It is an inspection graph: it lists what a re-key / rename would have to
touch or check, and it records every open requirement; it authorises nothing.
Statuses: established (per-row or per-member measurement, cited) | association (naming association, runtime unobserved) | candidate |
scoped-negative (a search that found nothing inside a stated scope) | open (not measured / not designed).
Usage: python r106_team_art_inspection_graph.py <out.json>

db.exhibitionteams.artid.note: shared art key (handoff 04); several rows per id

asset.fe_crest t{id}.big.inner_names: shared vocabulary (0, 1, sg1, sg2 + numbered pairs in a minority) - meaning open

edges.evidence: R56 per-row join (703 / 703 Legacy); developer resolver
R103: 703 / 703 rows, every discriminating row; runtime selection unobserved

edges.relation: file name texlib_{artid}_{a}_{b}; a, b = candidates
edges.evidence: R103: ref. resolves 687 / 703 rows, 1244 tuples without a row; R105: a larger family overlapping the jersey file tuples (Legacy X360: 796 of 905 jersey tuples in common, 109 jersey-only, 1 130 logo-only); 'retired variants' and 'per-kit logo' are hypotheses; family label 'rink logo' inherited, unverified

full-family comparison for nameplate and 'rink logo' members only (R103b {'jersey:chunklzx:decoded==loose': 904, 'logo:chunklzx:decoded==loose': 1926}); jersey / pant / sock / centre logo: 12 sampled pairs per family (R104 {'kit_jersey:chunklzx:equal': 12, 'nameplate:chunklzx:equal': 12, 'kit_pant:chunklzx:equal': 12, 'kit_sock:chunklzx:equal': 12, 'rink_logo:chunklzx:equal': 12, 'center_logo:chunklzx:equal': 12}) - other pairs unchecked; equal bytes say nothing about which copy the game reads

edges.relation: name dictionary 0xEC0010 names every raster with the member's own tuple (jersey_/font_/pant_/sock_/name_/logo_/centerlogo_ + numbers)
edges.evidence: R104 self_name {'kit_jersey:self': 5428, 'nameplate:self': 904, 'kit_pant:self': 2933, 'kit_sock:self': 946, 'rink_logo:self': 5778, 'center_logo:self': 231}; renaming a file leaves these internal names stale - whether the runtime looks rasters up by these names is open

edges.relation: RW4 subreference / atom tables and external-arena list
edges.status: decoded: empty tables + three constant values
edges.evidence: R104: decoded subreference counts {'0': 5871}, atom counts {'0': 5871} (empty tables); external-arena list = three observed constant values {'04000000 ffb00000 04000000': 5871} on every member (their meaning is not decoded); see the separately scoped string / hash search edge; internal raster names remain a known dependency (self-name edge)

edges.relation: ASCII stem or djb2 path hash
edges.evidence: R104: ASCII outside dictionaries 0; djb2 hits 0 over 5979008 bytes (random expectation 23.294); raster payloads not searched

edges.relation: fixed-width slot {u16 dir | basename}, row = {block, 0, size, djb2(path)}, rows in payload-offset order

open_requirements: same-length rename vs changed-length name-table rebuild (slot width = longest basename; dir table; payload offsets; archive_size)
header word 0x10 (unexplained)
runtime lookup key (name / hash / index / offset) and cache behaviour
internal RW4 raster names (0xEC0010) - rewrite or keep; runtime use unknown
loose-vs-archive precedence (which alias the game reads)
destination occupancy across DB team-art namespace, loose-only files, other archives / titles
rink-logo positions 2-3 and the family meaning
FE crest BIGF inner-name vocabulary (numbered pairs)
raster payload bytes (not searched; noise-dominated)
titles other than Legacy for payload references; PS4 (renames refused)
transaction / recovery design
